notes.title: New Patch (14.5.2025) is live now!
notes.content:
👋 Hey everyone!
We’re excited to announce that another patch has dropped for Magic Madness! Check out all the new features and improvements below—and most importantly, enjoy the game, join our Discord, and don’t forget to invite your friends!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527164/e3517bcfc302aa2dda4aee83f9fcdbc5ae175416.png[/img]

🔍 Full Patch Notes
🧠 Smarter Bots
Bots now come in multiple difficulty levels. Whether you're learning the ropes or craving a challenge, there's a bot for you.
📢 Discord Button
Join the community faster than ever—hit the new Discord button on the main menu to jump into the conversation.
🌲 New Arena: Green Dragon (Wood)
Battle beneath the canopy in the brand-new Green Dragon arena. Dense trees, winding paths, and hidden strategy await.
👑 New Character: Frog Princess
Graceful, agile, and surprisingly deadly. The Frog Princess hops into the roster with unique abilities and a royal attitude.
🔇 Match Mute Options
Need focus or peace? You can now mute or unmute players mid-match directly from the scoreboard.
💚 Team Health Bars
Know who needs help at a glance—your teammates now display green health bars above their heads.
💥 Damage Boosters Rebalanced
They now reduce incoming damage by 50%. Use wisely, survive longer.

notes.title: Magic Madness Patch 17.4.2025 – Now Live
notes.content:
🎮 Quick Match System
The new ‘Play Now’ button matches you with players based on server and ping. Maps, teams, and bots are randomized for quick action.
🧪 Training Match (Sandbox Mode)
Explore arenas, test spells, and set up custom fights. No pressure, just practice.
🔥 Fire Arena Rework
Improved layout and updated visuals for better flow and clarity.
🔧 Visual & Audio Improvements
– Fire Spell has new VFX
– Metal Spell visuals updated
– All skins now display visual effects correctly
– Animations improved across several characters
– Background music now plays on all maps
🏃 Movement & Menu Updates
– Unified movement speed: running is now consistent across maps
– In-game menu now opens on button hold and closes on release
🖥 Valve Index (Experimental Support)
Initial support added. Still in testing, but improving fast.
